minutes.headline: Planning Board reworked the draft zoning use table and will rewrite the Summer Street overlay uses and permit authority
minutes.summary: The board went through the red-line corrections to the definitions and use table draft, settling wording on architectural variation, sidewalks, lot coverage and impervious area, and discussed townhouse density in the Whalom district. Most of the time went to the Summer Street overlay and the medical marijuana bylaw, both to be redrafted. The only vote captured was adjournment.

decisions.decision: Use 'architectural variation' in place of 'articulation in the horizontal and vertical planes' for flat-roof commercial buildings.
Use the term lot coverage for what all buildings cover in the definitions.
Impervious area wording to read that the total impervious area shall not exceed, dropping 'lot devoted to'.

Summer Street overlay to be rewritten with its own list of by-right and special permit uses, with the Zoning Board as the single special permit authority and the Planning Board doing site plan approval.
Medical marijuana bylaw to say retail, processing and/or cultivation; agricultural processing term to be researched for a better word.
A redline draft compared to existing section four will be prepared for Town Meeting; a sign proposal is to be ready for the 12th; meeting schedule to be added to next agenda.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board agreed to rewrite the Summer Street overlay with its own by-right and special permit uses, the Zoning Board as sole special permit authority, and Planning Board site plan approval.
The board settled wording for the medical marijuana bylaw (retail, processing and/or cultivation) and will research a better term than agricultural processing.
The board agreed to use 'architectural variation' for flat-roof commercial buildings in the draft definitions.
The board settled on lot coverage as the term for what all buildings cover, and reworded the impervious area limit.
A redline draft compared to existing section four is to be prepared for Town Meeting; the only vote captured was adjournment.

why_it_matters: The Summer Street overlay and the use table decide what can be built where, and which board (Zoning Board or Planning Board) a property owner or neighbor must go before, so the rewrites shape what residents may later be asked to approve at Town Meeting.
